◆ instanceName

DynamicString superdex::robotics::SceneUrdfOptions::instanceName = DynamicString("real")

Links and joints of a bot that fills a slot are named "{slot}_{instanceName}_{name}", and other bots' "{entry}_{name}".

Base-scene actors keep their names, prefixed with "{prefab}_" for each nested prefab. Defaults to "real".
